design.historical_versions: Reconstructed expected manifests adopt the actual persisted v1/v2/v3 schema version before projection, retaining the Core historical projection rules and avoiding timestamp changes.
design.p40: SAME_CLASS_DEEPER; widen the existing manifest identity check to the complete Core profile projection instead of adding another field-specific assertion.
design.profileless: No explicit profile selector is still accepted only when the default persisted envelope projection matches the expected writer profile.
design.source_invariant: Resolve the linked envelope view, bind exact selected bytes, rebuild its expected manifest with canonical Core API from writer options and expected context, reuse the persisted created_at and persisted manifest schema version, then compare canonical profile projections.
design.tests: The red test writes actual same-schema, same-bytes envelope views with different tenant context and redirects the authority link to the foreign selected profile while retaining the payload/envelope bytes and schema markers.

sequence: Apply and run the red-only authority manifest identity test (expected failure before implementation).
Apply implementation patch plus R3/V3 companions after the red-only patch, then run the authorized focused controls.
